_comment: Second Brain seat seed — installed by the orchestrator to /data/seat.json on first deploy (or after a reset). Shape matches GET /api/seat: {updated_at, updated_by, projects: [{id, title, status, detail, next_step, blocked_on, links}]}. Edit via the /api/seat POST API, not this file directly — this is a reference/seed copy checked into git.

projects.title: NenTera SSD restore
projects.detail: NenTera's SSD failed 2026-07-03. Host has been down since; Trainer is acting as interim fleet admin over Tailscale/SSH to Ashaman. Replacement SSD is in hand.
projects.next_step: Run the extract script Wed 7/8 to pull the TCG canonical DB and configs off the old drive before reimaging.

projects.title: TCG price-fetch interim workaround
projects.detail: Ashaman's mirror keeps sales/orders flowing, but the daily price fetch normally runs on NenTera. Parked on hold per Aern until NenTera is back up.
projects.next_step: Revisit once the NenTera SSD restore lands — likely just re-point the scheduled task at Ashaman in the interim, or wait it out.

projects.title: Fable → successor model handoff
projects.detail: Documenting fleet conventions, gotchas, and lessons learned so a new model generation can pick up full context cleanly. This second-brain layer (seat/queue/needs-Aern) is the durable part of that handoff.
projects.next_step: Keep seat.json and queue.json current as work moves across sessions and machines — this is the thing that replaces re-deriving context from scratch.
